card.text: Red dwarf 11 arcseconds from HD 189733 A, moving with it through space.

introduction.text: HD 189733 B is a small red dwarf, a fifth of the Sun's width. It shares HD 189733 A's path through space at least 226 AU away.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture, edge darkening or axis is measured.
